title: Sun Goddess in Vortex
description: A blonde female figure in golden ornate attire floats dynamically above a swirling vortex of blue, white, and yellow energy. She holds a glowing sun-like emblem while surrounded by sunflowers, ethereal birds, dark clouds, and shadowy figures in a dramatic stormy sky with golden light breaking through.
prompt: A beautiful blonde woman with flowing hair wearing intricate golden belly dancer style armor and crown floats gracefully in the center of a swirling blue and gold energy vortex. She holds a glowing sun emblem in one hand while sunflowers and turquoise birds spiral around her. Dark stormy clouds fill the sky with golden light breaking through from above. Shadowy figures and birds appear in the background. Dramatic fantasy scene with swirling motion and ethereal effects.
